svg.title: Monthly 5-Minute Grid Coverage by Station (May 2025 – Nov 2026 UTC)
svg.desc: Heatmap matrix showing monthly numeric grid coverage percentages for four Red Deer River discharge gauges and Sylvan Lake water level. River gauges stay near 79–100% each month, whereas Sylvan Lake drops to 1.0% in Nov 2025, 0.0% from Dec 2025 to Mar 2026, and 4.1% in Apr 2026.
svg.text: Figure 1. Monthly 5-Minute Grid Coverage by Station (UTC)
Percentage of inferred 5-minute UTC slots with numeric values (2025-05-03 to 2026-11-03). Sylvan Lake has a 6-month winter gap (Nov 2025 – Apr 2026).
Winter lake gap: removes 48,571 river-only timestamps on non-lake dates

Source: Frozen WSC/ECCC 5-min archive (output/final_eda/coverage.csv; denominator = 158,112 inferred UTC slots; 2026-11 is partial through Nov 3). Exact percentages printed in every cell so no value depends on colour.
